title_en: US to supply Ukraine with $15 billion in weapons in 2026, Rutte says
text_en: US to supply Ukraine with $15 billion in weapons in 2026, Rutte says WASHINGTON, Feb 14 — RIA Novosti. The United States will supply Ukraine with $15 billion in weapons in 2026 under a procurement program funded by NATO allies, NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte said. "They are delivering (weapons worth — ed.) a billion euros a month. So this year it will amount to about 15 billion dollars, or 12 billion euros, including critical, lethal and non-lethal items, including interceptors for destroying Russian missiles," Rutte said in an interview with the American TV channel PBS. Earlier, US President Donald Trump stated that the US no longer funds Ukraine, but receives money for arms deliveries through NATO. On July 14, Trump announced a new scheme of military aid to Ukraine: Washington sells weapons to European NATO allies, who pay for them and transfer them to Kyiv.

title_en: Tips for Cooking Sacrificial Meat to Minimize Cholesterol from an Internal Medicine Specialist
text_en: Tips for Cooking Sacrificial Meat to Minimize Cholesterol from an Internal Medicine Specialist TEMPO.CO, Jakarta - Internal medicine specialist at Muhammadiyah University General Hospital of Jember, Norma Rahayu Najikhah, shares tips on cooking sacrificial meat during Eid al-Adha to minimize cholesterol and thus prevent disease."In managing cholesterol, meat processing is important, so people need knowledge about processing the sacrificial meat they will consume," she said in Jember, Saturday, 15 June 2024.According to her, high cholesterol content can cause various chronic diseases. However, cholesterol is actually important and needed by the body because it functions as a raw material for forming hormones, structure, and cell repair."Furthermore, that substance also functions to produce bile acids, which digest fats. Cholesterol also functions to form vitamin D and maintain the structure of the body's cells," she said.She explained that red meat from goat, cow, and sheep contains more iron than white meat such as chicken. Iron is needed for the formation of red blood cells."In addition, red meat contains more vitamin B12 and protein that is easier to digest than white meat. The recommended red meat consumption per day is 170 grams," she explained.She said good red meat processing means choosing only meat without fat. Besides choosing, the way to cook red meat should use low-fat coconut milk or candlenut as an alternative."Accompanying drinks that can be paired with meat are high-antioxidant drinks, vitamins C and E, which can help prevent cholesterol absorption in the body and increase excretion of low-density lipoproteins (LDL) in the blood," she said.Pay attention to your lifestyleBesides processing, a good lifestyle must be applied. Adding physical activity and losing weight are the best health solutions. If already obese, avoid cigarettes because they can lower good fat in the body, and also avoid stress and excessive alcohol because they can disrupt cholesterol metabolism and increase bad fat."Consuming sugar is also a cause of poor health because it can cause obesity, which triggers insulin resistance, resulting in diabetes mellitus," she explained.Norma explained that diabetes can trigger inflammation and chronic inflammation and damage the inner lining of blood vessels, causing atherosclerosis, which is a major problem in heart disease."To prevent all diseases caused by excess cholesterol and diabetes, we recommend the Dietary Approaches to Stop Hypertension (DASH) method, which focuses on increasing fruit and vegetables, at least five servings a day," she advised.In addition, consuming whole grains such as brown rice or whole wheat bread is also highly recommended. Then, limit foods high in saturated fat, trans fat, salt and sugar, which are important steps of this method."Be wise in choosing and processing food, maintaining your diet, and being active should be done every day, not only during Eid al-Adha," she stressed.Editor's Choice: Ahead of Eid al-Adha, See How to Cook Beef So It Is Tender and Soft

title_en: Jorge Amado's granddaughter launches unpublished children's book in Salvador
text_en: Jorge Amado's granddaughter launches unpublished children's book in Salvador The writer Maria João Amado launches, on January 18 at 2:30 pm, the children's book A Triste História de Adamastor in an independent micro-edition, with a limited print run of only 100 copies. The event takes place at Casa do Rio Vermelho in Salvador and is open to the public.With a proposal that combines humor, mystery and delicacy, the work presents a domestic tragedy narrated from the point of view of its non-human inhabitants. Read Also: Theater for R$ 10: show holds special session in Salvador Margareth confirms presence at Carnival: "Singing and satisfying" Culture Secretary highlights strength of the Ouro Negro Program at the Lavagem do Bonfim The story invites children and adults into a shared reading, as unlikely as it is entertaining, marked by accessible language and subtle irony, which expands the possibilities of interpretation.Granddaughter of writer Jorge Amado, the author chooses a space loaded with symbolism for the launch, reinforcing the affective and literary character of the encounter between the work, readers and Brazilian cultural memory.Service:Book launch: A Triste História de AdamastorAuthor: Maria João AmadoVenue: Casa do Rio VermelhoDate: January 18, 2026Time: 2:30 pmPrint run: 100 copies

title_en: Un Posto al Sole, previews for January 16: Marina and Roberto go on the attack again with a new plan
text_en: Un Posto al Sole, previews for January 16: Marina and Roberto go on the attack again with a new plan Tonight on TV, "Un Posto al Sole" returns, the soap opera set in Naples that tells the stories of the residents of Palazzo Palladini, in Posillipo. Among new twists, revelations and confrontations, here together are the previews and details of what will happen today, Tuesday, January 16. Appointment as always at 8:50 pm on Rai 3. Sanremo 2024, song report cards: Bertè rock queen (9), The Kolors' catchy hit (8), Rose Villain incoherent (4) The previews After discovering the truth about Ida, Diego is very disappointed in his friend. Knowing that the woman sold her son for money first to Lara and then to Marina and Roberto will lead him to decide to distance himself from her. A decision not shared by Raffaele. The father, in fact, is convinced that the young man should think it over more carefully and with a cool head, and he will invite him not to make hasty choices. Meanwhile, after being exposed, Marina and Roberto will try to save their plan, making Ida a new proposal, which the young woman could decide to accept for her own good and that of her child. Finally, after the apology letter published online, the situation for Guido becomes even more complicated: the municipal officer will in fact face a real war at home.
